text:
Five Richmond men's lacrosse players named to national freshman rankings
J. K. Kelly
Five incoming Richmond men's lacrosse players have been named to the Nike Lacrosse/Inside Lacrosse Freshman Rankings, with two ranked among the nation's top 40, according to an Aug. 19 announcement from the university.
Richmond's five selections place the program eighth nationally among all Division I schools and make it the only Atlantic 10 team represented on this year's list of top incoming freshmen. The Spiders' five ranked freshmen are behind only Notre Dame, Maryland, Johns Hopkins, Virginia, Duke, Princeton, and Harvard in number of selections.
Midfielder Gavin Gilmore leads Richmond's group at No. 32 in the rankings. He is followed by attackman Matthew Ford at No. 39, defenseman Michael Marino at No. 53, attackman Hunter Harris at No. 69, and defenseman Matthew Meredith at No. 99.
The new recruits come from a range of high school programs: Gilmore from Paul VI (Va.), Ford from Hill Academy (Ontario), Marino from Don Bosco Prep (New Jersey), Harris from Western Reserve Academy, and Meredith from Boys' Latin.
This marks a continuation of recent success for Richmond in recruiting nationally recognized talent. Previous recruits Gavin Creo ('27) was ranked No. 62; Aidan O'Neil ('26) was ranked No. 63; Joe Sheridan ('26) was ranked No. 82; and Vincent Gaylord ('29) was ranked No. 75 in their respective classes' Nike Lacrosse/Inside Lacrosse Freshman Rankings.
Those earlier recruits went on to play significant roles for Richmond's program: O'Neil, Sheridan, and Creo all became All-Americans, while Gaylord made an immediate impact by earning Atlantic 10 Rookie of the Year honors in 2026.
